name: Conceptual Physics Notes Course Profile
role: Course-specific Notes layer. Follows the universal/Algebra Notes architecture but uses substantially more source-grounded reading, more visual narrative, and more content-specific discussion checkpoints.

bank_canonical.rule: Finalized Unit Bank owns canonical WTC / Notes Example / Notes YTI wording, values, figures, and solutions.
bank_canonical.pair_rule: Use the Physics Bank profile: no more than four canonical Example/YTI pairs per section; Base Notes consumes every canonical pair actually present.

architecture: Section title + exact Learning Target / I-can statements
substantial reading/visual cycles organized by exact I-can/progression
content-specific Stop and Discuss immediately after each substantial reading segment
interleaved canonical Example / You Try It anchors
Vocabulary with definitions immediately before Summary
Framework-defined final miscellaneous workspace when required

reading.benchmark: Conceptual Physics/Hewitt extracted source library first; OpenStax/course-aligned text second
reading.rule: Physics Notes are textbook-like instructional reading, not thin blurbs between problems. Use slightly more reading than Algebra when the concept needs it; bold target vocabulary at first meaningful introduction.
reading.paragraphs: multiple short developed paragraphs; avoid walls of text and one-sentence stacking

visual_storytelling.hard_rule: Inspect the relevant Hewitt captured-image set BEFORE drafting the section narrative. Build portions of the explanation around the strongest images so the images help tell the conceptual story.
visual_storytelling.not_decoration: A figure should earn space by advancing the idea, evidence, prediction, comparison, or explanation.

stop_and_discuss.rule: More frequent than Algebra is appropriate. Every substantial reading gets an immediate content-specific S&D; additional short checkpoints may follow strong visuals/prediction moments. Do not automatically place S&D after every YTI.
stop_and_discuss.hewitt_source: Think and Discuss / Think and Explain / Think and Rank structures are preferred inspiration.

reading_apprenticeship.rule: Keep annotation, notice/wonder, evidence, model-reading, and representation interpretation opportunities purposeful; student workspaces may be generous for Notability.

student_teacher.student: clean Notability-first page with generous fixed workspace where required
student_teacher.teacher: same instructional sequence with direct answers/acceptable reasoning/evidence-to-listen-for in red/bold support; teacher workspaces expand naturally and never overlap
